title: Calibrating the Evaluator: Does Probability Calibration Mitigate Preference Coupling in LLM Agent Feedback Loops?

stages.details: The local source hash is checked; publication identity is separate.
Claims must be registered and bound to evidence fields.
Native gates passed: 0; bound to the current source: 0. A completed experiment is not a reproduced experiment.
Passed citation gates bound to the current source: 1.
Open Critical or Major findings block the package.
Mechanical packageability is separate from scientific readiness.
Upload, account use and publication require explicit user authorization.

next_actions.done_when: Each claim is verified, explicitly hedged with missing evidence, or removed.

next_actions.reason: Open review findings remain: p9-upstream-method-review, p9-statistics-recheck.
next_actions.done_when: No open Critical or Major finding remains against the current hashes.

next_actions.reason: Blocked claims cannot enter strong prose: C05, C06, C07, C09, C10.
next_actions.done_when: Blocked claims are absent from manuscript assertions or repaired.

next_actions.reason: Native gate receipts failed: p9-number-carrier, p9-controls.
next_actions.done_when: Each failed gate is repaired or explicitly blocked in the manuscript scope.

next_actions.reason: No bibliography file is visible in the overlay.
next_actions.done_when: Every citation resolves to a source record or is marked unresolved.

next_actions.reason: No experiment has a reproduced receipt in this overlay.
next_actions.done_when: Required numeric claims have a command, environment and matching output hash.

next_actions.reason: The package manifest contains unresolved blockers.
next_actions.done_when: The source tree, bibliography, compiled PDF and hashes are complete.

next_actions.reason: Q-One cannot perform an account-level arXiv action on its own.

notes: A mechanical package check is not scientific readiness.
